scientific_queries.note: Target-definition robustness check of the R51 pool curve; no literature query.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round confirms the threshold while explicitly reporting that the fine structure is noisy and non-monotone.

design.identical_to: R51 (same data, training set, pool sizes, k values, splits and seed)
design.only_change: hit definition switched from the true top decile to the Synergy boolean (base rate about 1.4%)

threshold_robustness: R51's top-decile and R52's Synergy boolean both place the crossover at 1,000-3,000 (k=20) and 3,000-10,000 (k=50), so the threshold does not move with the target definition even though the effect sizes differ about fourfold
H134_confirmation: at k=50 and pool 21,652 the boolean target gives +4.50 pp [+2.40,+6.40], matching R37 and R48, so the R37 construction is reproduced
noise_explanation: at a 1.4% base rate the expected hits in k=20 is about 1.5, so the CIs are roughly +/-2 pp wide

register_updates.C28: added threshold robustness together with the caveat that effect sizes and fine structure are not robust

next_gates: turn the rule into a callable decision predicate (pool size and k in, use-the-mix out) and compare it against random selection under the same information
